items.quote: the man of God is buried; lay my bones beside his bones. For the message he declared by the word of the Lord against the altar
items.contrast: Whether the warning was originally declared by the man of God or by the father speaking to his sons.
items.reason: The father is the one now saying that the message will come true, so he is a plausible alternative. However, “he declared” refers back to the man of God, establishing him as the source of the warning. The question clearly asks whose warning it was.
